subject: Battlefield
text: This battlefield features Ghosts, Zombies, and Red Bones.

evidence.quote: This time, you'll be facing off against Ghosts (a new type of creature), Zombies and Red Bones.

subject: Zombies and Ghosts
text: Zombies and Ghosts can take large damage from White Magic or Cure Potions.

evidence.quote: Zombies and Ghosts can be fiven large damage by White Magic or Cure Potions, if you need an edge to help you.

subject: Battlefield
text: The reward for clearing this battlefield is 1200 EXP.

evidence.quote: Reward  - 1200 EXP

subject: Battlefield
text: When finished with the battlefield, head east to the Volcano.

evidence.quote: When your finished, it's time to head east, to the Volcano.

subject: Volcano
text: Opening the chest beyond the door past the Ware Wolf yields the powerful White Wizard magic.

evidence.quote: Open the chest to recieve the powerful White, Wizard magic!

subject: Volcano
text: Two chests on the raised platform contain Heal Potions and Refreshers.

evidence.quote: Now, if you defeat the ghost on the right, then move down, on the raised platform, fighting the Were Wolf and Red Bone, you can reach two chests, one with Hwal Potions, and one with Refrshers.

subject: Volcano
text: Heading north to another screen via stairs blocked by a Skeleton leads to a door with some bombs.

evidence.quote: If you head north, to another screen, via the stairs a Skeletons blocking, you can take a door to get some bombs.

subject: Volcano
text: Moving left past some stairs and defeating enemies yields a few cure potions.

evidence.quote: This time move left, until you pass some stairs. Defeat the enemies, to get a few cures.

subject: Volcano
text: The next area of the Volcano has thick gas that makes enemies invisible unless you have a mask.

evidence.quote: Now, the next area of the Volcano has thick gas, that will make the enemies invisible - Unless you have a mask, which you'll get in a little while, a few screens ahead from where you are now.

subject: Volcano
text: A chest reached by going left and down steps through a door contains Heal Potions.

evidence.quote: Navigate to the right, until you come out in front of a chest. Get the Heal Potions, and head right, up more stairs, to another screen.

subject: Volcano
text: Continuing straight on the next screen leads to a chest with more bombs inside.

evidence.quote: Continue straight to get a chest with more bombs inside.

subject: Mask
text: A chest just beyond a Ware Wolf at the top of the stairs contains the Mask, enabling you to see enemies through gas.

evidence.quote: Beat the ghost on your left, and move up the stairs, to defeat a Ware Wolf. Just beyond him, is the chest with the Mask inside. Now you'll be able to see enemies through the gas on the other screens of the volcano!

subject: Volcano
text: A Nitemare to the left of the stairs blocks a chest containing Cure Potions.

evidence.quote: Before heding back down, though, left of the stairs, is a Nitemare, who's blocking a chest of Cure Potions.

subject: Volcano
text: Defeating the two enemies on the right grants access to a chest with 3 Cure Potions inside.

evidence.quote: Defeat the two enemies on the right, to reach a chest with 3 Cure Potions inside.

subject: Volcano
text: Fighting the Nitemare and Were Wolf on the left allows you to reach a chest with Heal Potions.

evidence.quote: If you fight the Nitemare and the Ware Wolf on the left, you can reach a chest with Heal Potions.

subject: Volcano
text: Moving down the stairs Medusa was blocking returns you to the world map with access to the Lava Dome.

evidence.quote: After you beat Medusa - which isn't a terribly hard battle - move down the stairs she was blocking. You'll go back to the world map, but now you'll have access to a new part of the volcano - The Lava Dome!

subject: Lava Dome
text: In the Lava Dome cave, bomb the rock on the lava platform, defeat the Stheno, and open the chest to reveal the Life Spell.

evidence.quote: Jump to them, and bomb the rock, and jump to the next platform - The one with a Stheno on it. Defeat the Stheno, and open the chest, to reveal the valuable Life Spell!

subject: Lava Dome
text: Taking the door on the left and dropping down after defeating an Iflyte leads to a chest with 3 refreshers.

evidence.quote: You can also take the door on the left, and drop down (after defeating an Iflyte - Doing this brings you to a chest with 3 refreshers.)

subject: Lava Dome
text: Blowing up boulders on the lava platform and ascending stairs beyond a Stheno leads to chests with 3 Cure Potions and the Moon Helm.

evidence.quote: From here, jump in front of the boulders on the platform on your left, bomb them, and jump over. Defeat the Stheno and head up the stairs. A few enemies later, and you'll have access to two chests - One with 3 Cure Potions, the other with the valuable Moon Helm armor!

subject: Lava Dome
text: In the cave past the Hot Wings and Fangpire, jumping across stone steps and fighting the Adamant Turtle reaches a chest with bombs.

evidence.quote: After defeating him, jump across the stone steps in the lava, and fight the Adamant Turtle, to reach a treasure chest with some bombs inside.

subject: Lava Dome
text: Another cave contains chests on the right containing Cure Potions, Heal Potions, and Refreshers.

evidence.quote: If you do some fighting, you can reach chests on the right; They contain Cure Potions, Heal Potions and Refreshers.

subject: Lava Dome
text: Stepping on a switch outside after defeating an Iflyte opens a door on another platform.

evidence.quote: Defeat another Iflyte outside, and step on a switch, to open a door on another platform.

subject: Lava Dome
text: Entering the cave to the right after dropping down reveals a chest ahead containing 3 potions.

evidence.quote: After that, head down the stairs, and go right, to the cave; Enter it. Ahead, is a treasure chest, that contains 3 potions

subject: Lava Dome
text: After defeating a Salamand and a Stheno in the next room, you reach two treasure chests with Cure Potions and Heal Potions.

evidence.quote: After defeating a Salamand, and a Stheno, you'll reach two treasure chests - One with Cure Potions, and one with Heal Potions.

subject: Lava Dome
text: Fighting through the upper door allows you to reach 2 chests that both contain Cure Potions.

evidence.quote: You can fight, to reach 2 chests (Both contain Cure Potions) and then leave, through another door on the left.

subject: Lava Dome
text: In the room with lots of lava, cure potions are found in the north-west corner, and Cure Potions are in the south-east.

evidence.quote: There are cure potions on the noth-west corner of the room, a Stheno and Cure Potions on the South-east, and the Dualhead Hydra in the top-middle - No it isn't an item, it's a boss!

subject: Sun Coin
text: After defeating the Dualhead Hydra and saving the Fire Crystal, open the chest to obtain the Sun Coin.

evidence.quote: After the battle's over - Assuming you won of course - you'll save the Fire Crystal!...Open the chest to get the Sun Coin, then either leave, or use exit.

subject: Battlefield
text: This battlefield contains Stheno and Iflyte enemies and has lots of Unexpected Attacks.

evidence.quote: Enemies - Stheno + Iflyte...For whatever reason, this place has lots of "Unexpected Attacks".

subject: Battlefield
text: The reward for clearing this battlefield is 1068 EXP.

evidence.quote: Reward  - 1068 EXP

subject: purple door
text: In Focus Tower, the Sun Coin opens the third (purple) colored door.

evidence.quote: With the Sun Coin, you'll be able to open the third one (purple.)

subject: Doom Castle
text: Defeat the Minotar Zombie in Doom Castle and open the chest to receive the Aero spell.

evidence.quote: Defeat the Minotar Zombie, and open the chest, to recieve the Aero spell.

subject: Reuben
text: On the Rope Bridge, Reuben defends you against a Mummy but is knocked off the bridge, leaving you to fight alone.

evidence.quote: A mummy will appear, and Reuben will try to play the role of a Hero, and defend you. He ends up being knocked off the bridge though, leaving you to fight alone - Not that the Mummy is strong.

subject: Tristam
text: After defeating the Mummy and climbing down to see Reuben, Tristam joins you.

evidence.quote: Defeat it, and Hero will automatically climb down, to see Reuben. He says he'll catch up later - and then who should come by, but Tristam.

subject: Rope Bridge
text: Climbing down the second vine on the bridge yields Cure Potions.

evidence.quote: Make sure to climb down the second vine if you want some Cure Potions.

subject: Rope Bridge
text: Climbing down the fifth and final vine on the bridge yields 3 seeds at the bottom.

evidence.quote: You'll also want to climb down the fifth and final vine - There are 3 seeds at the bottom.

subject: Rope Bridge
text: Exiting from the right side of Rope Bridge leads to Alive Forest on the world map.

evidence.quote: Grab the seeds, then climb back up the vine, and exit the area from the right side. On the world map, head right, to Alive Forest.

subject: Medusa
text: Start by taking out the two Were Wolves seperately, then have Reuben use his Morning Star on Medusa, and don't stop using white with Hero against Medusa (5,000HP).

evidence.quote: Medusa - 5,000HP*...Wizard Magic. Start by...taking out the two Were Wolves seperately, then have...Reuben use his Morning Star on Medusa....Don't stop using...white with Hero.

subject: Dualhead Hydra
text: Dualhead Hydra has 14,000HP; first of all, make sure you have the Moon Helm, being strong against fire attacks is a must.

evidence.quote: Dualhead Hydra- 14,000HP...First of all, make sure you have...the Moon Helm - Being strong against fire attacks is...a must! That being said

subject: Dualhead Hydra
text: The basic strategy for this battle should be to have Hero use White every turn, while Reuben uses his Morning Star, or heals when it becomes necessary.

evidence.quote: That being said, the basic strategy for this...battle, should be to have Hero use White every turn,...while Reuben uses his Morning Star, or heals when it...becomes necessary.
